purpose: final-report extension: which replicated conclusions depend on the published LQR weights (Q Eq. 43, R Eq. 44)?

design.reduction: single-input (Ad, 2b) as in twip/lqr.py; K is per motor

solver_credibility.note: the paper's backward recursion reproduces the DARE; the DARE is invariant under joint (Q, R) scaling, so only the ratio rho = s_Q/s_R matters

plant_mechanism.note: two zeros sit ON the unit circle at z = 1 (reaction-wheel non-minimum-phase structure at T0 = 10 ms): they cap the achievable bandwidth, so the Riccati solution saturates and the weights barely move the design

crossings.note: scale value at which the LQR curve crosses the fixed PID/SMC baseline level; empty list = no crossing within [0.01, 100]×
